title: GPU, thermal and power
description: The GB10 on every Spark: what it is doing, what it draws, how hot it runs and whether it is throttling.

panels.title: GPU busy
panels.description: The worker rank spins while it waits, so this reads high when nothing useful is happening. Read it with power.

panels.title: Busy by process
panels.description: Worker_TP at 95 % with low power is the rank waiting at a collective. GNOME and remote desktop sessions use the GPU too.

panels.title: GPU memory by owner
panels.description: Unified memory held by CUDA contexts, attributed through each process's cgroup.

panels.title: GPU temperature
panels.description: A shared SoC temperature: heavy CPU work moves it too. Slowdown at 86 °C, shutdown at 90 °C.
